title: Irrigation Checklist
subtitle: Farm Irrigation: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Irrigation Checklist covers field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response. The irrigation coordinator records Farm Irrigation criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Irrigation Checklist keeps Farm Irrigation exceptions visible until the irrigation coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Irrigation Checklist at water source, pump station, mainline, valve zone, field, and runoff boundary. Document field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response identity before Farm Irrigation begins. Compare field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response findings with stated Farm Irrigation criteria; route unresolved Farm Irrigation issues to farm water-system reviewer.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Farm Irrigation, identify responsible parties, water source, pump station, mainline, valve zone, field, and runoff boundary, and the linked field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response source.

fields.label: Water source, permit or allocation reference, and pump
Zone, valve, line, meter, and controller

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Farm Irrigation facts for field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Farm Irrigation inspection checks
items: Leak, blockage, emitter, sprinkler, and uniformity
Runoff, erosion, ponding, and neighboring impact

columns.label: Target flow, duration, coverage, or condition
Observed reading, leak, runoff, or result
On target, issue, or not checked
Adjust, repair, stop, or follow up

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: Before closing Farm Irrigation, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Irrigation Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Reading or delivered volume cannot be reconciled
blocks.guidance: Pause Farm Irrigation when water authority, supply, equipment, delivered volume, runoff, or field-impact concern remains unresolved. Retain the available Farm Irrigation proof and route unresolved field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response scope to irrigation coordinator.
